welcome.liruf_intro: I'm Liruf, your co-pilot. You'll learn things about money that school never taught you — in a way you'll never forget.
welcome.liruf_bubble: Hey! New here? 🎉 What you're about to learn will change how you see money forever!
welcome.dina_bubble: Hi! I'm Dina 🧡 Ready for your first adventure?
welcome.rho_bubble: Dr. Rho 🧭 I'll draw your learning map.
welcome.zara_bubble: Zara here 💅 Time to think like a founder.
welcome.characters_intro: And my friends Dina, Dr. Rho and Zara will be with you every step of the way.

name.question: What's your name?
name.subtitle: So we can celebrate your wins with you. ✨
name.liruf_done: {{name}}! What an awesome name! Get ready to be famous here 🌟
name.liruf_bubble:
First things first — I need to know what to shout when you win your first lesson! 🏆

What's your name?
name.liruf_error_empty_bubble: Hey! Your name? 🤨 I can't shout "hey, you!" when you win!
name.liruf_error_invalid_bubble: Dr. Rho's runes? 🙏 Letters only, please.

age.question: How old are you?
age.subtitle: We'll personalize your learning path based on your stage in life.
age.dina_done: {{age}} years old! 🎂 I know exactly how to guide you. This is going to be amazing!
age.dina_bubble: {{name}}, so nice to meet you! 🧡 How old are you? That way I can prepare exactly what you need.
age.dina_error_empty_bubble: {{name}}, your age? My antenna can't guess 🙃

interests.title: What do you want to learn?
interests.subtitle: Pick the topics that call to you most. You can choose several.
interests.rho_bubble: Key moment, {{name}} 🗺️ Tell me what sparks your curiosity and I'll map your perfect route.
interests.rho_first_selection_bubble: Excellent choice! 🗺️ That topic has a lot of potential.
interests.rho_multiple_bubble: Look at you go! 🚀 More territory = more power. I like it.
interests.rho_error_bubble: {{name}}, pick at least one treasure. 🧭 Don't leave without a route!

experience.title: How much do you know about finance?
experience.subtitle: Be honest — wherever you are right now, we'll take you further.
experience.zara_bubble: Last step, {{name}} 💅 No matter where you are today, we'll take you further than you imagined.
experience.zara_hover_beginner: Perfect starting point! 💪 The best founders started from zero.
experience.zara_hover_some: You're already ahead! ✨ Let's turn that into superpowers.
experience.zara_hover_expert: Love that level! 🔥 A real challenge. Let's see how far we can go.
experience.zara_selected_bubble: Let's go! 🚀 Your personalized adventure is ready. No turning back.
